suggestions.title: Publish the fair-line card before the market posts
suggestions.decision: Do you want a pre-market number or a post-market comparison?
suggestions.benefit: A pre-market number is a genuine origination; a post-market number is a benchmark.
suggestions.risk: Pre-market lines have no liquidity check and will look wrong against the closing number.
suggestions.cost: Low — the model already runs from graded history only.
suggestions.recommended: Start with the post-market comparison (today's build) and add a frozen 24-hours-before snapshot once the schedule feed is wired to a cron job.

suggestions.title: Licence a timestamped prop and SGP price archive
suggestions.decision: Approve the spend, or accept that props stay blocked.
suggestions.benefit: Unblocks prop and parlay strategies, the two families the owner explicitly asked for.
suggestions.risk: Data rights, cost, and coverage gaps for lower-profile players.
suggestions.recommended: Do not build prop models before the price history exists; a model with no price cannot be scored.

suggestions.title: Recover an official depth-chart feed
suggestions.decision: Accept computed tiers, or fund a real depth-order source.
suggestions.benefit: Turns the tier column from 'computed' into 'official', which is what the owner asked for.
suggestions.risk: An unofficial depth source would immediately violate the no-hallucination rule.
suggestions.recommended: Keep computed tiers labelled as computed. Chase the official page from CI, where the 404 may not reproduce.

suggestions.title: Score strategies on the interval lower bound, not ROI
suggestions.benefit: Stops the highest-variance strategy from topping the board by luck.
suggestions.risk: Conservative scoring can hide a genuinely good small-sample strategy.
suggestions.recommended: Adopt it; it is already the default in this build.

suggestions.title: Freeze a prospective paper trial for the two least-bad strategies
suggestions.decision: Pick a horizon (e.g. the rest of 2026) and freeze the version.
suggestions.benefit: Only a prospective, pre-registered trial can promote a strategy past gate G7.
suggestions.risk: A short horizon will not settle anything; a long one delays the leaderboard.
suggestions.recommended: Freeze the totals-from-scoring-rates strategy (largest sample, smallest interval) for the remainder of 2026.

suggestions.title: Extend the injury tracker to every game of the week
suggestions.benefit: Makes the tracker usable for the actual slate instead of three games.
suggestions.risk: Transcription error; each row needs its source URL and a blank-safe schema.
suggestions.recommended: Parse the official page rather than transcribing it, and keep the verbatim capture as the audit trail.

suggestions.title: Add snap counts and participation data
suggestions.decision: Decide whether the extra data source is worth the licence/effort.
suggestions.benefit: The only way to measure a backup's actual workload rather than infer it.
suggestions.risk: Not reachable from this environment; would need CI or a licensed feed.
suggestions.recommended: Do it before any injury-adjusted line is published.

suggestions.title: Show a model-vs-market error table per season
suggestions.benefit: Makes it obvious where and when the model lost, instead of one summary number.
suggestions.recommended: Built. The per-season splits are on the Backtest page.

suggestions.title: Separate 'no data' from 'zero' everywhere
suggestions.benefit: Stops a blocked strategy being read as a losing strategy.
suggestions.recommended: Built: blocked strategies show BLOCKED and a blank profit, never 0.

suggestions.title: Add a monthly re-verification job
suggestions.benefit: Keeps the official cross-checks (standings, injury pages, stats leaders) from going stale.
suggestions.risk: CI minutes; silent drift if a page changes markup.
suggestions.recommended: Run the validator monthly and fail loudly on any mismatch, listing both numbers.

suggestions.title: Publish the licence status of the price archive
suggestions.decision: Decide whether price-derived figures may be shown publicly.
suggestions.benefit: Removes a legal unknown from the project.
suggestions.risk: If the answer is 'no', the backtest pages must be removed.
suggestions.recommended: Ask the maintainer in writing; until then keep the figures labelled NOT OFFICIAL.

suggestions.title: Promote only after a full-season prospective trial
suggestions.risk: A full season is a long wait.
suggestions.recommended: Adopt; the engine already refuses to mark anything reward-eligible.

howToUse: Read the decision column first. Nothing is implemented until a decision is recorded here; DONE items are already live so the reviewer can judge them.

scoring.risk: what could go wrong, and how badly
scoring.reversibility: how cheaply it can be undone
